extracted.name: Best Caprese Skewers
extracted.description: These caprese skewers are super simple to make. Your guests will love these fun, bite-sized salad appetizers of mozzarella, fresh basil, and tomatoes.
instruction_lines: Toss tomatoes, mozzarella, olive oil, basil, salt, and pepper together in a bowl until well coated.
Skewer one tomato and one piece of mozzarella on each toothpick.
